## Project Overview
A spice/food product e-commerce landing page (HTML/CSS/JS) with product cards, hero section, stats strip, about section, gallery, testimonials, and contact form.

## Completed Work
- Built full landing page with navbar, hero, stats strip, about, products, why-us, gallery, testimonials, contact, and footer sections
- Styled with CSS custom properties, animations, responsive grid layouts
- Product cards have image, badge, title, description, weight info, and CTA button
- Weight format updated to mixed format: `100gm | 200 gm | 500gm | 1kg` (no space before gm for 100 and 500, space for 200, 1kg for last)
- Fixed `.product-weight` CSS truncation issue: removed `white-space: nowrap`, `overflow: hidden`, and `text-overflow: ellipsis`; replaced with `white-space: normal` and `overflow: visible` so full weight string displays without clipping

## Key Technical Decisions
- 4-column product grid (`repeat(4, 1fr)`)
- `.product-weight` now uses `white-space: normal; overflow: visible;` — allows full weight text to wrap and display completely

## Relevant Files & Code
- `index.html` — main HTML file
- `style.css` — all styles; `.product-weight` at lines 591–598 updated to remove truncation properties
- `script.js` — JavaScript for interactivity

### `.product-weight` (style.css, lines 591–598) — current state:
```css
.product-weight {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--red);
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: normal;
  overflow: visible;
  display: block;
}
```

## Current Status
Fix applied and confirmed. The `.product-weight` truncation issue is resolved. Full weight string `100gm | 200 gm | 500gm | 1kg` now displays completely on all product cards.

## Pending Tasks
- None currently outstanding
